landing.heroSubtitle: AfriDev Hub connects African developers who build, document real-world solutions and look for collaborators across borders.
landing.pillarShowText: Publish your projects, their stack, their country context and how you want to collaborate.
landing.pillarSolveText: Document the problems found in the field, from mobile money payments to KYC APIs.
landing.pillarProveText: Every verified contribution feeds an auditable reputation ledger and leaderboards.
landing.howSubtitle: Problem → solutions → accepted solution → field report → country confirmation.
landing.step1Text: Describe the real blocker, the API involved and the country context.
landing.step2Text: Another developer brings an explanation and runnable code.
landing.step3Text: The accepted solution becomes an enriched field report linked to the API.
landing.step4Text: Developers from the same country confirm it works in the field.
landing.finalTitle: Build your reputation, one contribution at a time.
landing.finalText: From accepted solutions to sponsored missions, every step is documented.
